note: Asking prices in euros from the original listing on the day each home was added. Medians describe the homes RealHunt lists (cheap for their country, checked by a person), not a country's whole market. Rules, taxes and costs are general information, not legal or tax advice.
sentences: On 26 November 2026, RealHunt lists 3 homes for sale in Colombia, each one checked by a person.
In Colombia, the median asking price of those 3 homes is €176,300 (€1,377 per m², from the 3 homes with a known size); the cheapest costs €165,200 and the most expensive €203,500.
With 3 homes this is a small sample, so the median for Colombia is a rough guide.

buying.costs_breakdown: Notary fees of 3 per thousand of the price (2026), customarily split between buyer and seller; registry fees of 9.11 to 13.33 per thousand depending on the price, plus 2%, paid by whoever asks for the registration, usually the buyer; and the registration tax (impuesto de registro), whose rate each department sets.
buying.can_foreigners_buy: Yes. A home bought by a foreigner counts as foreign investment, which needs no prior authorization and is treated the same as investment by residents. When the money comes in through the foreign exchange market, the exchange declaration serves as its registration with the Banco de la República.
buying.annual_property_tax: Impuesto predial unificado: each municipality sets the rate between 5 and 16 per thousand of the cadastral value (avalúo catastral).

homes.title: Fully remodelled three-bedroom house in a gated complex with pool, Santa Marta
homes.title_es: Casa de tres dormitorios completamente remodelada en complejo cerrado con piscina, Santa Marta
homes.summary: Asking COP 590,000,000 (about €165,200) for a two-storey house of about 120 m² in a gated residential complex in Rodadero Reservado, the quiet area north of El Rodadero beach in Santa Marta on the Caribbean coast. It has just been fully remodelled in a modern style: a new kitchen with stone-look worktops and gas hob, glossy tiled floors, a steel-railed staircase and new bathrooms with glass showers. There are three bedrooms, the main one with its own bathroom and dressing area, a separate study and a guest toilet. Balconies look onto green hills, and the complex has a large shared pool. Maintenance fee not stated.

homes.title: Two-storey house with a mountain-view balcony and estate pool in Santa Fe de Antioquia
homes.title_es: Casa de dos plantas con balcón con vistas a las montañas y piscina de finca en Santa Fe de Antioquia
homes.summary: Asking COP 650,000,000 (about €176,300). A 150 m² two-storey house on a 170 m² plot in a gated country estate at Santa Fe de Antioquia, the colonial town in the warm valley northwest of Medellín. Downstairs is an open living and dining room with an island kitchen, opening onto a covered terrace and a lawn garden. Upstairs are three air-conditioned bedrooms under timber-beamed ceilings, the main one with a balcony looking straight at the mountains, and two bathrooms. Parking for two cars. The estate has 24-hour gatehouse security, CCTV, a pool, a steam room and a social hall. Fees: administration COP 550,000 a month (about €150).

homes.title: Sea-view four-bed flat on the 16th floor one block from Marbella beach, Cartagena
homes.title_es: Piso de cuatro dormitorios con vistas al mar en la planta 16 a una manzana de la playa de Marbella, Cartagena
homes.summary: Asking COP 750,000,000 (about €203,500). A 132 m² flat on the 16th floor of a 9 to 15 year old tower in Marbella, one block from the beach and close to the historic centre. A long glass balcony looks over the sea, and the open living room has an island kitchen with dark stone worktops. There are four bedrooms with fitted wardrobes, the main one with a dressing room, four bathrooms, four air-conditioning units, two parking spaces and a storeroom. The building has a pool, gym, games room and sports court. Fees: building administration COP 750,000 a month (about €200).
